Team —

Thanks for flagging time this week. I attached a first-pass manager playbook for the upcoming review window. This is intentionally narrow: the doc focuses on handling sensitive role changes, staggered comms, and brief scripts for managers when asked by employees or peers. High-level asks: 

- Please review pages 3–6 ("Sensitive-case flow") and the proposed quiet-mode timeline.
- Send redlines or concrete script suggestions by EOD Thursday (2027-03-18).
- Marcus: can you take a pass on the escalation matrix and return an editable XLSX?
- Neha: HR compliance checks and any mandatory redaction steps — please highlight gaps.

Why this approach: several teams have changes that shouldn't be broadly announced until offers/HR checks are complete. We need a lightweight manager kit that preserves dignity and reduces accidental disclosure.

I plan to circulate a manager-facing summary and a single-line manager script (for 1:1s) once we lock edits. If we can get an approved quiet-launch email draft, managers will have something to use if questions spill into public channels.

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop

Thanks — good first draft. A few compliance / HR items to add before we call this "final":

- Data minimization: managers should not keep separate notes (e.g., redacted hiring rationale) outside the official system. Add a short policy blurb and a link to the secure folder (see related_links).
- Redaction checklist: if a role change is sensitive, require HR to review comms before any external message; add a 24-hour sign-off SLA.
- Offer letter & onboarding hold: ensure recruiting confirms any offers are signed before broader manager comms.
- Training: require a 30-minute "sensitive conversation" refresh for managers involved in changes; target completion within 5 business days of escalation.

I've attached the relevant policy snippet and looped in Alicia from the PeopleOps consultancy for an extra compliance scan. Alicia — if you can review the proposed 24-hour sign-off and comment, that would be great.

Neha Kapoor
Head of HR Operations
Redwood Inference

Team —

Thanks for the fast turn-around. Based on Marcus and Neha's input plus Alicia's comments, we've agreed the following and I'm marking owners so we can move to lock: 

Decisions (final):
- Manager playbook updated to v1.1 (attached). Includes: explicit owners per step, two-line public scripts for urgent asks, and the 24-hour HR sign-off process. (Owner: Neha)
- Escalation matrix v1.1 with owner columns and 48–72hr stagger guidance for >30-person orgs. (Owner: Marcus)
- Quiet-launch email draft for managers is attached; managers will use that for direct questions if they cannot defer.
- Mandatory 30-minute sensitive-conversation refresh scheduled for managers on any impacted team (Owner: Maya).

Timeline (high level):
- 2027-03-18 17:00 PT — managers receive final kit (done).
- 2027-03-22 09:00 PT — managers complete quick refresh (target).
- 2027-03-23 to 2027-03-25 — staged 1:1 manager notifications & HR sign-off window.
- 2027-03-26 10:00 PT — optional company-level comms (only if all offers/HR checks complete).

Quiet-launch email (manager-facing draft):
Subject: Quick note on team updates (for direct questions)
Hi <name>,
I wanted to let you know there may be some team updates over the next few days. If you have questions, please reach out directly to your manager — we’ll share details broadly once HR confirms paperwork and a timing window.
Thanks for your patience and please do not share unconfirmed information publicly.

Next steps for each owner: 
- Neha: finalize redaction checklist and capture sign-off flow (due 2027-03-19 EOD).
- Marcus: publish escalation_matrix_v1.1 with owners (due 2027-03-19 EOD).
- Maya: schedule the 30-minute refresh sessions and share calendar invites (due 2027-03-20).

I'll file these artifacts in the manager playbook folder and notify leadership after the sign-offs are complete. If anything unexpected comes up, escalate to me directly.

—Lauren

Redwood Inference
